objectives.co_op_rules: Flip primary objectives equal to the # of players, everyone must complete a primary objective with the flipped secondary objective
objectives.versus_tertiary: Most money at end of run

entries.text: Got to and consume every shrine you are offered.
Go into every room you are guaranteed to spend money in (shops, taverns, arcades, blacksmiths) and spend as much money as you can, even if it kills you.
